description: This is a PHP source file implementing a view class for the undo step in an import process within the SuiteCRM application. It manages the user interface for undoing the previous import, including rendering templates and executing undo operations.

classes.name: ImportViewUndo
classes.description: A view class extending ImportView that handles the undo last import functionality, including rendering the undo interface and executing the undo operation.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the undo import interface, executes the undo operation, and displays the resulting templates.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code to handle the user interaction after the undo operation, specifically assigning values and submitting the form.
